blurb: Guests join interactive pirate adventures aboard the Black Spirit, a 50-foot pirate ship with 12 cannons, engaging in treasure hunts, water cannon battles, and live storytelling. Experiences include family-friendly cruises, birthday parties, school and camp outings, adult private charters, and corporate events. The ship sails in False Creek and English Bay, offering waterfront views and a lively pirate atmosphere.
extraNote: Sailings run by reservation and need at least 12 pirates aboard to set sail · If minimum crew not reached, may reschedule or cancel sailing with early notice
